mapper.sql: SELECT t.tag_id, t.owner_user_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_key, t.document_type, t.material_category, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.remark, COUNT(DISTINCT d.document_id) AS document_count, t.status FROM sys_tag t LEFT JOIN sys_document_tag dt ON t.tag_id = dt.tag_id LEFT JOIN sys_document d ON dt.document_id = d.document_id AND d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.tag_id = #{tagId} GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.owner_user_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_key, t.document_type, t.material_category, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.remark, t.status
